states.name: bcd_count
states.meaning: Registered 16-bit BCD counter value; q[3:0] is ones, q[7:4] tens, q[11:8] hundreds, q[15:12] thousands.
states.update_time: posedge clk; reset has priority over increment

rules.condition: reset == 1 at posedge clk; q becomes 0x0000 and combinational ena becomes 0 after q settles.
reset == 0 at posedge clk; q_next = BCD_add(q,1) modulo 10000, with carry across nibbles and wrap from 0x9999 to 0x0000.

rules.spec_quote: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: first sampled posedge with reset low after a sampled reset high

mid: Optional mid changes to reset after sampling are carried to the start of the next row and are evaluated at the next sampled posedge.

uncertain.note: The active-high synchronous reset is explicit, but the reset value of q/ena is not stated; assumed q=0 and therefore ena=0 after the edge.
candidates: reset clears q to 0 and ena to 0
reset leaves q and ena unchanged
reset sets q and ena to an unspecified value

uncertain.note: Normal increment is grounded by 'counter', but 4-digit overflow/wrap behavior is not explicitly stated; assumed modulo 10000.
candidates: increments modulo 10000 with wrap from 9999 to 0000

uncertain.note: Enable equations are inferred from BCD carry semantics; bit mapping and combinational vs registered timing are not explicitly stated.
candidates: ena[0]=ones==9, ena[1]=tens==9&&ones==9, ena[2]=hundreds==9&&tens==9&&ones==9, combinational from q
same equations registered on posedge clk
reverse mapping of ena bits to upper digits
